channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Gold Dispute Turns Violent in Mehdipatnam, Couple Attacked with Knife in Hyderabad
item.description: A family dispute over gold turned violent in Mehdipatnam’s First Lancer area, Hyderabad, after a man allegedly attacked a couple with a knife. Police have registered a case and begun investigation.

item.title: Telangana CM stresses on traffic problem in Greater Hyderabad, appoints young IPS officers
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy has posted young IPS officers to strengthen law and order and address key public concerns, particularly traffic congestion in the Greater Hyderabad.

item.title: Indian Union Muslim League Telangana State Preparatory Meeting ahead of Municipal Elections held in Hyderabad GHMC Office at Bahadurpura Office
item.description: The State President of the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML), Telangana, Advocate Mohammed Shakeel, today asserted that the party is fully prepared and confident of delivering a strong performance in the forthcoming Municipal Elections in Telangana, which are expected to be held in the coming days.

item.title: ₹362-Crore Development Boost for Khammam: CM Revanth Reddy Lays Foundation Stones in Edulapuram
item.description: CM Revanth Reddy launches ₹362-crore development works in Edulapuram, Khammam, including canals, colleges, hospitals, and market yards, boosting education and healthcare.

item.title: Pakistan: Unidentified attackers blow up bridge in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Mir Ali
item.description: A key bridge in Mir Ali tehsil of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa was blown up with explosives by unidentified attackers, causing severe difficulties for residents, local media reported on Sunday.

item.title: 5 killed, 80 injured in bus plunges into gorge on Chhattisgarh-Jharkhand border
item.description: In a tragic accident on Sunday, five persons lost their lives, and 80 others sustained injuries after a bus fell into a gorge near the Orsa Bangladara ghati on the Chhattisgarh-Jharkhand border. The incident occurred under the jurisdiction of Mahuadanr police station, sending shockwaves through the local community.

item.title: Kite Dispute Turns Violent in Langar House, Constable Suffers Nose Fracture
item.description: A kite-related clash in Langar House, Hyderabad, left a police constable with a fractured nose after stone-pelting. Police registered cases and launched a search for the accused.

item.title: Do Your Kids Watch Too Many YouTube Shorts? Here’s a New Tool Parents Should Know
item.description: YouTube introduces a Shorts Feed Time Limit feature to help children and parents control daily short-video screen time. Available on Android and iOS devices.

item.title: Hyderabad Horror, Youth Murdered in Knife Attack Near Wine Shop in Shamsheer Gunj
item.description: A youth from Karnataka was stabbed to death near a wine shop in Shamsheer Gunj under Chatrinaka police station limits in Hyderabad Old City. Police are probing love angle and other motives.

item.title: From Municipal Elections to Metro Phase-2, Telangana Cabinet Takes Several Big Decisions — Check All Details
item.description: Telangana Cabinet chaired by CM Revanth Reddy decides to hold municipal elections at the earliest and approves major irrigation, metro, temple, and infrastructure projects during a historic Medaram meeting.
